Summary
: This study deals with Karmic Astrology and its presentation in Vedic and the later Sanskrit literature. The ancient Indian science of Astrology (known in Sanskrit as Jyotish-shastra) is based upon perceptive natural phenomenon of cosmic light forms. While the Concept of Karman basically means “action according to Vedic injunction” such as the performance of meritorious sacrificial work.
